aiChat.title: AI Assistant
aiChat.description: The chat assistant on your storefront: answers from the catalog and your pages, hands over to WhatsApp.
aiChat.providerNotReady: The model API key ({{env}}) is not set on the server: the assistant is hidden on the storefront.

overview.budgetHint: When the budget is spent, visitors only see the WhatsApp button until the next day ({{tz}}).
overview.pricing: Prices per million tokens: in {{input}}, out {{output}}, cache read {{read}}, cache write {{write}}
overview.noPricing: No prices known for this model: costs show as $0. Set `pricing` in the plugin options.

drawer.title: Conversation
drawer.deleteConfirm: Delete this conversation and its messages? This cannot be undone.

settings.enabledHint: Switch the assistant off to hide it on the storefront immediately.
settings.budgetHint: Empty = plugin default ({{default}}). Counts input, output and cache tokens at the prices above.
settings.greetingHint: First message in the chat panel, per language.
settings.instructionsHint: Added to the assistant's instructions (tone, what to mention). It cannot override the safety rules: no invented prices, no promises, no payment data.
settings.faqsHint: Short questions the assistant may answer directly. Everything else comes from the catalog, your pages or CS.
